THIS MOVES NO MONEY — issue the actual refund in the gateway’s cabinet first; this marks the payment Refunded and replays the member’s remaining chain (D-084/D-085). Idempotent: repeating it on an already-refunded payment changes nothing.

New members per bucket plus a cumulative total. Buckets are cut at LOCAL (Asia/Tashkent) midnight and empty ones are returned as zeros; the cumulative line includes everyone who registered before the window.

Confirmed revenue per bucket split by gateway, plus this window against the previous one. GROSS: a refund removes its amount from the day it was paid, and `growthPct` is null when the previous window earned nothing.

Subscriber flow per bucket as events on the grant chain: new (first-ever grant), renewals, reactivated (returned after a gap), churned (a covered span ended and nothing continued it), and net = new + reactivated − churned.

Registered → paired a device → received a grant → paid, measured on ONE cohort: the members who registered inside the window. Every step asks “ever”, so a refund or a deleted child profile cannot lower a closed cohort’s conversion. `bucket` draws no series here — it aligns the window with the charts above.

Four donuts in one request — plan, payment provider, subscription state and device platform. Current-state snapshots, so it takes no range and ignores any query parameters. Every donut is zero-filled: a plan or gateway nobody has used yet is a 0% slice, never a missing one.

info.title: Oila 360 API
info.description: Main backend API (https://api.oila360.uz/docs/api.json), merged with the high-frequency device-telemetry ingest service (https://api.oila360.uz/docs/ingestion.json). Captured live 2026-08-13. Both documents sit behind HTTP basic auth; /api/docs-json — the URL this snapshot used to be fetched from, and which OpenAPI/README.md records as 404 — was replaced by those two paths, so this file IS refreshable again.

mode.description: audio = mic only, video = camera + mic

delivered.description: Whether FCM accepted the push. FALSE is a soft failure: stream.* has no poll fallback, so the device will never hear the command — fail fast, do not wait. TRUE does NOT mean the child is publishing yet.

transport.description: Informational only. 'poll' is a lie for stream.* (there is no stream-command poll endpoint) — it is reused because DispatchResult allows only these three. Switch on `delivered` alone.

room.description: Server-derived LiveKit room. Join this — never re-derive it client-side.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Server-owned lease. The child stops publishing when it expires; re-POST /stream/start at roughly half this to renew while the live screen is open.
